Inspired by consistency learning [28, 9], enforced on
the output of models through different augmentations of
an image, we propose our cross-domain attention consis-
tency loss to learn attention-level consistency and induce
a model to generate robust attention maps. The idea is
rather straightforward: The attention maps from two differ-
ent augmented views from the same image should always
be consistent. With this objective, the model can learn to
predict more consistent attention maps on both source and
target images without supervision and further contribute to
attention-level domain alignment.
Combining our cross-domain prediction consistency loss
and cross-domain attention consistency loss, CDAC not
only facilitates alignment on the output level but also brings
the alignment to the attention level and improves the seg-
mentation accuracy under UDA settings. To summarize, our
key contributions in this work include:
1. We introduce a cross-domain prediction consistency
loss that encourages robust attention as well as predic-
tion across domains and thus helps with the attention-level and output-level domain alignment;
2. We propose to enforce attention-level consistency via
our cross-domain attention consistency loss to further
assist the alignment of attention-level discrepancy;
3. CDAC is verified in extensive experiments to be
effective, reliable and generalizable under different
scenarios and achieves state-of-the-art performance
on several important UDA semantic segmentation
benchmarks including GTA V-to-Cityscapes, Synthia-
to-Cityscapes and Cityscapes-to-ACDC.

per_question_results.question: MAPSeg 如何统一处理异构医学图像分割中的多种域偏移？
per_question_results.ground_truth: MAPSeg 基于 3D 掩码自编码和伪标签技术，构建了一个统一的 UDA 框架。它系统性地处理了异构医学图像分割中的四种不同域偏移（模态差异、扫描仪差异、站点差异、协议差异），是该领域首个能同时处理这么多类型域偏移的框架。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您解答关于MAPSeg如何统一处理异构医学图像分割中多种域偏移的问题。

根据知识库内容，MAPSeg通过以下方式实现对多种域偏移的统一处理：

1. 它是首个系统性应对**四种不同域偏移**的框架，涵盖跨序列（如T1/T2序列间组织对比度差异）、跨机构（如不同扫描仪和采集参数导致的对比度变化）、跨年龄（如婴儿脑发育过程中白质/灰质对比度动态变化）等典型异构性来源【来源：《Zhang_MAPSeg_Unified_Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_Heterogeneous_Medical_Image_Segmentation_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf》】。

2. 采用“**掩码自编码+伪标签**”双路径协同机制：  
   - 基于掩码图像建模（MIM），特别是掩码自动编码器（MAE）和掩码伪标签（MPL），提升模型对缺失/失真信息的鲁棒表征能力【来源：《Zhang_MAPSeg_Unified_Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_Heterogeneous_Medical_Image_Segmentation_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf》】；  
   - 结合教师-学生框架，由教师模型为完整目标域图像生成高质量伪标签，并通过一致性正则化引导学生模型学习【来源：《Zhang_MAPSeg_Unified_Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_Heterogeneous_Medical_Image_Segmentation_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf》】。

3. 具备**跨部署场景的统一适应能力**：可同时支持集中式、联邦式及测试时（test-time）三种UDA范式，在不牺牲性能的前提下，满足医疗数据因HIPAA/GDPR等法规限制而无法集中共享的实际需求【来源：《Zhang_MAPSeg_Unified_Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_Heterogeneous_Medical_Image_Segmentation_CVPR_2024_paper.pdf》】。

综上，MAPSeg的“统一性”体现在其架构设计能兼容多类型域偏移与多部署模式，而非为每种偏移单独设计模块。如您需要了解具体技术实现细节（如MAE与MPL如何联合优化）、实验配置或代码使用问题，建议转接人工客服，我们将为您进一步对接技术专家支持。祝您工作顺利！

2. Related Work
2.1. Masked Image Modeling
Masked image modeling (MIM) represents a category of
methods that learn representations from corrupted or in-
complete images [7, 13, 26, 51], and can naturally serve
as a pretext task for self-supervised learning. For exam-
ple, masked autoencoder (MAE) trains an encoder by re-
constructing missing regions from a masked image input
and has demonstrated improved generalization and per-
formance in downstream tasks [24, 36, 38, 59, 65–67].
MAPSeg heavily relies on MIM, leveraging MAE and
masked pseudo-labeling (MPL), to achieve versatile UDA.
2.2. Pseudo-Labeling
Pseudo-labeling facilitates learning from limited or imper-
fect data and is prevalent in semi- and self-supervised learn-
ing [32, 40, 53]. Consistency regularization is widely used
in pseudo-label learning [39, 54], which is a scheme that
forces the model to output consistent prediction for inputs
with different degrees of perturbation ( e.g., weakly- and
strongly-augmented images). Mean Teacher [60], a teacher-
student framework that generates pseudo-labels from the
teacher model (which is a temporal ensembling of the stu-
dent model), is also a common strategy. In this work, we

Image Segmentation Based on 3D Masked Autoencoding and Pseudo-Labeling
Xuzhe Zhang1y, Yuhao Wu2y, Elsa Angelini1;3, Ang Li4, Jia Guo1, Jerod M. Rasmussen5,
Thomas G. O’Connor6, Pathik D. Wadhwa5, Andrea Parolin Jackowski7,
Hai Li2, Jonathan Posner2, Andrew F. Laine1z, Yun Wang2;8z
1Columbia University2Duke University3T´el´ecom Paris, LTCI, Institut Polytechnique de Paris
4University of Maryland, College Park5University of California, Irvine6University of Rochester
7Universidade Federal de S ˜ao Paulo8Emory University
Abstract
Robust segmentation is critical for deriving quantita-
tive measures from large-scale, multi-center, and longitu-
dinal medical scans. Manually annotating medical scans,
however, is expensive and labor-intensive and may not al-
ways be available in every domain. Unsupervised domain
adaptation (UDA) is a well-studied technique that allevi-
ates this label-scarcity problem by leveraging available la-
bels from another domain. In this study, we introduce
Masked Autoencoding and Pseudo-Labeling Segmentation
(MAPSeg), a uniﬁed UDA framework with great versatil-
ity and superior performance for heterogeneous and vol-
umetric medical image segmentation. To the best of our
knowledge, this is the ﬁrst study that systematically re-
views and develops a framework to tackle four different do-
main shifts in medical image segmentation. More impor-
tantly, MAPSeg is the ﬁrst framework that can be applied
tocentralized ,federated , and test-time UDA while main-
taining comparable performance. We compare MAPSeg
with previous state-of-the-art methods on a private infant
brain MRI dataset and a public cardiac CT-MRI dataset,
and MAPSeg outperforms others by a large margin (10.5
Dice improvement on the private MRI dataset and 5.7 on
the public CT-MRI dataset). MAPSeg poses great practical
value and can be applied to real-world problems. GitHub:
https://github.com/XuzheZ/MAPSeg/ .

per_question_results.question: pOSAL 为什么使用基于 patch 的输出空间对抗学习？
per_question_results.ground_truth: pOSAL 发现基于整体分割的对抗损失不足以驱动网络捕获分割细节，因此设计了基于 patch 的输出空间对抗学习框架，在 patch 级别进行细粒度判别，从而更好地解决不同数据集之间的域偏移问题，实现视盘和视杯的联合分割。

您好！感谢您的提问～😊

pOSAL 使用基于 patch 的输出空间对抗学习，主要原因如下：

1. 全图像（whole-segmentation-based）的对抗学习方式在捕捉分割细节方面能力较弱【来源：《汇报（2）Patch-based Output Space Adversarial Learning for Joint Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation_MICCAI_2018_paper.pdf》】；  
2. 为提升对局部结构相似性的建模能力，作者专门设计了 patch-wise（基于图像块）的判别器，用于捕获输出空间的局部统计特性，并引导分割网络更关注图像局部区域的结构一致性【来源：《汇报（2）Patch-based Output Space Adversarial Learning for Joint Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation_MICCAI_2018_paper.pdf》】；  
3. 这种 patch-based 设计实现了更细粒度（fine-grained）的判别与优化，从而有效提升分割精度，尤其在保留 optic cup 椭圆形态、确保其位于 optic disc 内部等关键解剖结构上表现更优【来源：《汇报（2）Patch-based Output Space Adversarial Learning for Joint Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation_MICCAI_2018_paper.pdf》】。

Patch-based Output Space Adversarial Learning
for Joint Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation
Shujun Wang, Lequan Yu, Student Member, IEEE, Xin Yang, Chi-Wing Fu, Member, IEEE,
and Pheng-Ann Heng, Senior Member, IEEE
Abstract —Glaucoma is a leading cause of irreversible blind-
ness. Accurate segmentation of the optic disc (OD) and cup
(OC) from fundus images is beneﬁcial to glaucoma screening and
diagnosis. Recently, convolutional neural networks demonstrate
promising progress in joint OD and OC segmentation. However,
affected by the domain shift among different datasets, deep
networks are severely hindered in generalizing across different
scanners and institutions. In this paper, we present a novel patch-
based Output Space Adversarial Learning framework ( pOSAL)
to jointly and robustly segment the OD and OC from different
fundus image datasets. We ﬁrst devise a lightweight and efﬁcient
segmentation network as a backbone. Considering the speciﬁc
morphology of OD and OC, a novel morphology-aware segmen-
tation loss is proposed to guide the network to generate accurate
and smooth segmentation. Our pOSAL framework then exploits
unsupervised domain adaptation to address the domain shift
challenge by encouraging the segmentation in the target domain
to be similar to the source ones. Since the whole-segmentation-
based adversarial loss is insufﬁcient to drive the network to
capture segmentation details, we further design the pOSAL in
a patch-based fashion to enable ﬁne-grained discrimination on
local segmentation details. We extensively evaluate our pOSAL
framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in improving the
segmentation performance on three public retinal fundus image
datasets, i.e., Drishti-GS, RIM-ONE-r3, and REFUGE. Further-
more, our pOSAL framework achieved the ﬁrst place in the OD
and OC segmentation tasks in MICCAI 2018 Retinal Fundus
Glaucoma Challenge .
Index Terms —Optic disc segmentation, optic cup segmentation,
deep learning, domain adaptation, adversarial learning

per_question_results.question: SimCLR 和 MoCo 在对比学习框架上有什么主要区别？
per_question_results.ground_truth: SimCLR 使用大型 batch size 和同一 batch 内的样本作为负样本，依赖数据增强和投影头来学习表示。MoCo 则使用队列和动量编码器构建动态字典，允许使用更大的负样本集，且不依赖超大 batch size。两者都是自监督对比学习的代表性工作，但 MoCo 通过动量更新机制解决了动态字典的一致性问题。

您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您解答关于SimCLR和MoCo在对比学习框架上的区别问题。

根据知识库内容，SimCLR与MoCo的主要区别体现在以下两点：

1. 架构设计上：SimCLR无需专门设计的网络架构（如MoCo所依赖的动量编码器等特殊结构），也无需使用内存银行（memory bank）来存储负样本；而MoCo明确依赖内存银行机制【来源：《ASimple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations.pdf》】。

2. 框架复杂度上：SimCLR被描述为“更简单”的框架，它简化了此前提出的对比学习算法，不依赖特殊架构或外部存储模块；相比之下，MoCo（如图1中列出的MoCo、MoCo (2x)、MoCo (4x)）属于需要额外组件（如动量更新、队列式负样本管理）的代表性方法【来源：《ASimple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations.pdf》】。

需要说明的是，知识库中未提供MoCo的具体技术细节（如动量更新机制、队列长度设置等），因此关于二者在训练策略、负样本采样方式等方面的更深入对比，当前资料暂不完整。

如您需要进一步了解MoCo的技术原理或二者在实际应用中的性能差异，建议转接人工客服，我们将为您安排AI算法专家为您提供详细解读。😊

A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
Ting Chen1Simon Kornblith1Mohammad Norouzi1Geoffrey Hinton1
Abstract
This paper presents SimCLR : a simple framework
for contrastive learning of visual representations.
We simplify recently proposed contrastive self-
supervised learning algorithms without requiring
specialized architectures or a memory bank. In
order to understand what enables the contrastive
prediction tasks to learn useful representations,
we systematically study the major components of
our framework. We show that (1) composition of
data augmentations plays a critical role in deﬁning
effective predictive tasks, (2) introducing a learn-
able nonlinear transformation between the repre-
sentation and the contrastive loss substantially im-
proves the quality of the learned representations,
and (3) contrastive learning beneﬁts from larger
batch sizes and more training steps compared to
supervised learning. By combining these ﬁndings,
we are able to considerably outperform previous
methods for self-supervised and semi-supervised
learning on ImageNet. A linear classiﬁer trained
on self-supervised representations learned by Sim-
CLR achieves 76.5% top-1 accuracy, which is a
7% relative improvement over previous state-of-
the-art, matching the performance of a supervised
ResNet-50. When ﬁne-tuned on only 1% of the
labels, we achieve 85.8% top-5 accuracy, outper-
forming AlexNet with 100 fewer labels.1
1. Introduction
Learning effective visual representations without human
supervision is a long-standing problem. Most mainstream
approaches fall into one of two classes: generative or dis-
criminative. Generative approaches learn to generate or
otherwise model pixels in the input space (Hinton et al.,
2006; Kingma & Welling, 2013; Goodfellow et al., 2014).

per_question_results.question: FDA 和 D-GAP 都利用了傅里叶变换，它们的方法有什么不同？
per_question_results.ground_truth: FDA（Fourier Domain Adaptation）通过直接交换源域和目标域图像的低频频谱来实现域适应，是一种无需训练的数据级方法。D-GAP 则是一种梯度引导的数据增强方法，通过任务梯度计算频率敏感度图，自适应地在源样本和目标样本之间插值幅度，同时结合像素空间混合。FDA 更简单直接，D-GAP 更复杂但针对性更强。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您解答关于FDA和D-GAP方法区别的问题。根据知识库内容，两者虽都基于傅里叶变换进行域适应或增强，但在设计目标、核心机制和实现方式上存在明显差异：

1. **目标与任务定位不同**  
   - FDA（Fourier Domain Adaptation）专注于**无监督域适应（UDA）中的语义分割任务**，旨在缩小源域与目标域之间的分布差距，提升模型在无标签目标域上的泛化性能【来源：《FDA.pdf》】。  
   - D-GAP（Gradient-guided Amplitude Mix）则是一种**面向跨域泛化的数据增强方法**，强调通过频率空间与像素空间协同增强，提升模型对分布偏移的鲁棒性与收敛稳定性【来源：《2511.11286v2.pdf》】。

2. **傅里叶操作的核心逻辑不同**  
   - FDA采用**无训练的频域对齐策略**：直接将目标图像的中心低频幅度（由掩码M_β控制）与源图像的全频段相位拼接，再经逆傅里叶变换生成风格迁移图像，从而实现“傅里叶对齐”【来源：《FDA.pdf》】。该过程不依赖梯度或模型反馈，是静态、确定性的频域替换。  
   - D-GAP提出**梯度引导的幅度混合（Gradient-guided Amplitude Mix）**：先计算模型对频率分量的敏感度图G(u,v)，再生成动态混合权重D(u,v)，据此自适应地融合源/目标图像的幅度谱；其混合比例由模型训练过程中的梯度信息驱动，而非人工预设【来源：《2511.11286v2.pdf》】。

3. **是否依赖模型训练与反馈**  
   - FDA是**无需训练的预处理方法**，不参与网络反向传播，仅作为输入增强手段【来源：《FDA.pdf》】。  
   - D-GAP的幅度混合模块**深度嵌入训练流程**，其混合操作受任务损失梯度影响，并参与端到端优化（如图4所示的Back Propagation路径）【来源：《2511.11286v2.pdf》】。

综上，FDA侧重于**无监督域适应下的频域风格迁移**，而D-GAP侧重于**监督学习中梯度驱动的频域增强**，二者在动机、机制与集成方式上均有本质区别。

如您需要进一步了解某项技术的具体实现细节（例如掩码参数β的选取依据，或D-GAP中敏感度图的计算公式），建议转接人工客服，我们的技术专家可为您提供更深入的解析。祝您研究顺利！

per_question_results.question: CaCo 和 ProCA 都使用了原型（prototype）概念，它们的方法有何异同？
per_question_results.ground_truth: CaCo 和 ProCA 都利用原型进行类别级别的特征对齐。CaCo 构建语义感知字典，将目标样本分配到基于源域类别先验的伪类别中，实现类别对比学习。ProCA 则将类间信息纳入类别原型，采用以类别为中心的分布对齐策略，将同一类别原型视为正例。两者都超越了单纯的实例对比，但 CaCo 更侧重于字典查找式的类别对比，ProCA 更侧重于类别原型的对比适应。
source_doc: Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf

This paper presents CaCo, a category contrast technique
that introduces a generic category contrastive loss that can
work for various visual UDA tasks effectively. We con-

2. Related  works
In this section,  we review recent advances  closely related to our 
work. These approaches  can be roughly  categorized  into four cate-
gories: (1) image alignment  methods,  (2) simultaneous  feature and 
image alignment  methods,  (3) disentangled  representation  learning  
methods,  and (4) prior knowledge  constraint  methods.
2.1. Image alignment  methods
Image alignment  methods  aim to reduce the domain  gap by trans-
forming  source-domain  images to mimic the style of the target domain.  
A common  strategy  involves  using image-to-image  translation  net-
works, such as cycle-consistent  adversarial  networks  (CycleGAN)  (Zhu 
et al., 2017 ), to generate  semantically  consistent  target-style  images 
from the source domain.  Similarly,  Huo et al. (2018 ) employed  a 
translation  network  to synthesize  images with target-domain  charac-
teristics  and used these generated  images along with their labels to 
train a segmentation  model. Zhang et al. (2019 ) introduced  content  and 
style discriminators  to preserve  structural  semantics  and enforce  noise 
patterns  consistent  with the target domain,  respectively.  However,  
these methods  often suffer from semantic  distortions  and artifacts  in 
the translated  images,  limiting  their effectiveness.
Furthermore,  Henry et al. (2021 ) improved  semantic  preservation  
through  conditional  GANs and L1 loss, yet required  paired data, which 
restricts  its scalability.  Other style transfer  methods  such as AdaIN (Gu 
and Ye, 2021 ) adapted  feature statistics  to align styles but were highly 
sensitive  to hyperparameter  settings.  Recently,  ISGAN (Li et al., 2024 ) 
employed  an improved  symmetric  GAN architecture  to enhance  cross-
modality  adaptation,  yet it may suffer from increased  training  com-

per_question_results.question: 哪些方法属于测试时适应（TTA）而不需要源域数据？
per_question_results.ground_truth: 属于测试时适应（TTA）且不需要源域数据的方法包括：GraTa（通过梯度对齐改进优化）、VPTTA（为每个测试图像训练特定提示）等。这些方法在测试阶段仅利用目标域数据和模型本身进行适应，不依赖源域训练数据。
per_question_results.answer:

根据知识库内容，以下方法属于**测试时适应（Test-time Adaptation, TTA）且不需要源域数据**（即支持“source-free”模式）：

1. GraTa：明确指出“TTA can be employed in a source-free and online manner, allowing the model to adapt without accessing the source data”【来源：《GraTa.pdf》】；  
2. TENT：在实验对比中被列为GraTa的竞品方法之一，且上下文说明所有对比方法均基于相同baseline和“single-iteration adaptation for each batch of test data”，符合source-free TTA范式【来源：《GraTa.pdf》】；  
3. DLTTA、DomainAdaptor、SAR、DeTTA、DUA、DIGA、MedBN：这些方法均被列为与GraTa同台对比的“eight competing TTA methods”，并统一在“source-free”设定下评估（如使用测试数据重统计BN、单步自适应等），因此也属于无需源域数据的TTA方法【来源：《GraTa.pdf》】。

Related Work
Test-time Adaptation
Test-time Adaptation (TTA) addresses domain shift by
adapting the pre-trained source model to the distribution of
the target domain using test data during inference (Liang,
He, and Tan 2024). TTA can be employed in a source-
free and online manner, allowing the model to adapt with-
out accessing the source data. The mainstream TTA meth-
ods are based on fine-tuning the model by constructing
self-supervised auxiliary tasks to guide the model in train-
ing on the test data, enhancing its performance and adapt-
ability (Wang et al. 2021; Sun et al. 2020; Zhang, Levine,

We trained a ResUNet-34 (He et al. 2016) backbone follow-
ing (Hu, Liao, and Xia 2022) as the baseline individually
on each domain (source domain) and subsequently tested it
on each remaining domain (target domain), computing the
mean metrics to evaluate all the methods across diverse sce-

2022). To deploy our GraTa, we utilized the Adam (Kingma

The scaling factor βis set to 0.0001 empirically.

per_question_results.question: 对比学习在域适应中的应用有哪些代表性工作？
per_question_results.ground_truth: 对比学习在域适应中的代表性工作包括：SimCLR 和 MoCo（自监督对比学习的基础框架）、MPSCL（医学图像分割中的自步对比学习）、CaCo（类别对比域适应）、MIC（掩码图像一致性中的对比学习）、以及 MC-CCycleGAN（对比 CycleGAN 中的对比损失约束）。这些方法利用对比学习来增强特征表示的判别性和域不变性。

per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问～根据我们知识库中的资料，对比学习（contrastive learning）在无监督域适应（UDA）视觉任务中的应用，已有若干代表性工作，具体如下：

1. Shuang Li 等人提出的“Semantic distribution-aware contrastive adaptation”，专门面向语义分割任务，通过语义分布感知的对比学习实现域适应【来源：《Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf》】。

2. Yawei Luo 等人提出“Category-level adversaries”，强调类别级对抗对齐以保障语义一致性，虽属对抗方法，但被知识库明确指出与对比学习形成互补——因对比学习可进一步增强“inter-category margin”和“intra-category compactness”【来源：《Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf》】。

3. Dilip Krishnan 的“Supervised contrastive learning”为对比学习提供了重要基础框架，虽非专用于域适应，但在后续 UDA 方法中被广泛借鉴【来源：《Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf》】。

4. Xinlei Chen 等人的“Momentum contrastive learning”（MoCo）作为改进型对比学习基线，也被用于提升域适应中特征表示的判别性【来源：《Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf》】。

需要说明的是：知识库中提及的对比学习相关工作均聚焦于**语义分割**或**通用视觉表征学习**，未涉及目标检测、图像生成等其他任务的具体对比学习方案；且所有引用均出自《Category Contrast for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Visual Task.pdf》这一来源。

Although the methods based on adversarial training have
achieved impressive progress in domain adaptation, most of
them are limited to align only the global marginal distribu-
tions of visual representations without considering semantic
consistency. To avoid the semantic confusion between the two
domains, some methods [10], [16], [17] have been proposed
to match the joint distribution of representation and category
between the two domains. In [10], Luo et al. proposed an
adaptively weighted adversarial loss to align each of categories
in the shared embedding space. Different from the implicit
category-aware alignment mentioned above, some explicit
methods [18], [19] tried to generate pseudo-labels for target
data by self-training, providing more powerful supervision
for classiﬁer training. As an anchor-guided UDA model for
semantic segmentation, both category-wise domain alignment
and self-training were facilitated in an explicit way [20].
Despite the category-wise domain alignment, the local se-
mantic structure in the embedding space was not adequately
considered in [20]. As a result, the inter-category difference,
which is crucial for dense pixel-wise prediction task, won’t
be sufﬁciently boosted. Fortunately, it has been shown in
some recent works [21]–[23] that contrastive learning can
help to learn powerful representations by taking a closer look
at both inter-category and intra-category distributions. Fig. 1
illustrates a comparison between category-agnostic models and
our proposed category-aware domain alignment. In contrast to
category-agnostic models, our model is more prone to inter-
category margin preserving by constructing enough semantic
prototype induced contrastive pairs for contrastive learning
while reducing the intra-category variation.

per_question_results.question: 哪些方法利用了 Transformer 或基础模型进行域适应？
per_question_results.ground_truth: 利用 Transformer 或基础模型的方法包括：CDAC（跨域注意力一致性 Transformer）、Distill-SODA（自监督 ViT）、SaLIP（SAM + CLIP 级联）、PFM-JONet（提示基础模型混合训练）、以及 MAPSeg（3D 掩码自编码）。这些方法借助 Transformer 或基础模型的强大表示能力来提升域适应性能。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问～根据我们现有的知识库内容，以下方法明确利用了Transformer或基础模型进行域适应：

1. DAFormer：该方法将Transformer模型引入无监督域适应（UDA）语义分割任务，并配合充分的训练策略，显著提升了性能，超越了基于卷积网络（convnet）的现有方法；文中明确指出“我们以DAFormer为骨干网络”【来源：《Wang_CDAC_Cross-domain_Attention_Consistency_in_Transformer_for_Domain_Adaptive_Semantic_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf》】。

2. HRDA：作为DAFormer的延伸，HRDA进一步在高分辨率场景下提升性能，同样基于Transformer架构【来源：《Wang_CDAC_Cross-domain_Attention_Consistency_in_Transformer_for_Domain_Adaptive_Semantic_ICCV_2023_paper.pdf》】。

3. Vision Transformers（ViT、DeiT、Swin、CSWin）及其在语义分割中的应用（如Segmenter、SETR、SegFormer）：这些Transformer-based模型被广泛用于语义分割任务，也为域适应提供了基础模型支持；知识库提到“Transformer-based模型正在推动医学图像分割中空间推理与语义表征的根本性重构”【来源：《applsci-16-00840-v2.pdf》】。

需要说明的是，知识库中未提及具体使用其他大语言模型（如LLaMA、BERT）或通用基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）进行域适应的内容。若您关注某类特定基础模型（如多模态模型或扩散模型）在域适应中的应用，当前知识库暂未覆盖，建议转接人工客服获取更深入的技术支持哦～😊

The prior works related to this paper are summarized below in domain adap-tation for semantic segmentation, cross-domain few-shot learning and few-shot
semantic segmentation.
Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation. Recent works in domain
adaptation for semantic segmentation are mainly divided into two directions.
One group of studies aims to learn domain-invariant representations of instances
by domain adversarial training [ 8,9,12,41]. Hoﬀman et al. [ 20] combine global
and local alignment methods with adversarial training. Similar ideas are also
explored using diﬀerent techniques, such as distillation loss [ 9], output space
alignment [ 40], class-balanced self-training [ 54], conservative loss [ 53], etc. The
other group is learning from a pre-deﬁned curriculum [ 31,51].
However, these methods operate in the setting where the target domain data
can be accessed during training to drive the model adaptation and compensate
for the domain shift. In addition, most existing works exploit photo-realistic
synthetic data. Thus, the source and target domain share the same label space

2.2. Unsupervised Domain Adaptation in Semantic Segmentation
Unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) [ 13,14] for semantic segmentation aims to
transfer knowledge from a labeled source domain to an unlabeled target domain, despite
significant shifts in data distribution and appearance. Over the years, UDA research has
evolved into several methodological paradigms, each addressing the domain gap from a
different perspective. Adversarial learning approaches align source and target distributions
by introducing domain discriminators, typically applied in output or feature space. Adapt-
SegNet [ 29] and HRDA [ 30] are representative examples that achieve pixel-wise alignment
through adversarial training at multiple scales. Appearance-level alignment methods,
such as CyCADA [ 31] and recent diffusion-based techniques, operate at the pixel level
by transforming source images to resemble target domain appearance, aiming to bridge
the visual gap while preserving semantic content. Discrepancy-based methods, such as
MCD [ 32], introduce multiple classifiers to expose ambiguous target regions by maximizing
inter-classifier disagreement, which is then minimized through adaptation, providing a
stable alternative to adversarial objectives. Self-training leverages high-confidence predic-
tions as pseudo-labels for target data. CBST [ 33] and DACS [ 34] use filtering and mixing
strategies. Mean Teacher [ 16] introduces temporal ensembling and consistency losses to
stabilize pseudo-labels. Entropy-based strategies (e.g., ADVENT [ 17]) aim to minimize
the uncertainty of model predictions in the target domain by reducing output entropy,
thereby encouraging confident and compact output distributions. This process implicitly

per_question_results.question: FDA 和 FAUDA-Net 都使用了傅里叶变换，但方法层次有何不同？
per_question_results.ground_truth: FDA 是在数据层面进行傅里叶域适应，通过交换低频频谱直接修改输入图像，无需训练。FAUDA-Net 则是在特征层面利用频率约束（相位和幅度分量）和频率感知对比学习来对齐域分布，需要在训练过程中学习。FDA 更简单直接，FAUDA-Net 更深层且与网络训练耦合。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您解答关于FDA与FAUDA-Net在方法层次上的区别问题。

根据知识库内容，FDA（Yang and Soatto, 2020）与FAUDA-Net虽均基于傅里叶变换，但在方法设计上存在三个关键差异：

1. **动态性 vs 静态性**：FDA采用静态的振幅交换（static amplitude swapping），即一次性、固定式的频域操作；而FAUDA-Net首次引入**动态分布自适应**（dynamic distribution adaptation），通过超分辨率增强（SR augmentation）和频率感知机制，在整个训练过程中持续演化特征分布，而非仅做单次变换【来源：《1-s2.0-S0895611125001934-main.pdf》】。

2. **处理结构**：FDA未提及多阶段或双向约束机制；相比之下，FAUDA-Net提出的BFDA模块实现了**显式的相位与振幅一致性约束下的双向同步适配**，避免了TSANet等两阶段方法中因顺序处理导致的误差累积【来源：《1-s2.0-S0895611125001934-main.pdf》】。

3. **框架整合度**：FDA作为早期方法，未涉及分布扰动或对比学习；FAUDA-Net则将**频域扰动、分布破坏（distribution disruption）与对比学习（FACL）统一于端到端框架内**，各组件协同作用——SR促进域不变表征，BFDA生成频率感知的对比样本，FACL的对齐结果又反向优化分布适配【来源：《1-s2.0-S0895611125001934-main.pdf》】。

综上，FAUDA-Net在动态性、双向协同性与系统集成性三方面显著区别于FDA等传统傅里叶域方法。

如您需要进一步了解某项技术细节（例如BFDA模块的具体实现或λ_C=0.1的调参依据），欢迎随时告诉我，我可为您补充说明。若涉及模型部署、参数复现等实操问题，也建议转接技术人工客服获取更深入支持。😊

3. Han et al., 2021 提出的“Deep symmetric adaptation network for cross-modality medical image segmentation”，同样聚焦于**跨模态医学图像分割的域适应**，强调对称式特征对齐【来源：《1-s2.0-S0895611125001934-main.pdf》】。

per_question_results.question: SAM 和 CLIP 在医学图像分割中如何被利用？
per_question_results.ground_truth: SaLIP 方法将 SAM 和 CLIP 级联使用：SAM 负责生成基于部件的分割掩码，CLIP 负责从掩码池中检索与目标区域对应的掩码，然后 SAM 根据检索结果进行精细分割。这种方法无需训练和领域专家知识，实现了零样本医学图像分割。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您解答关于SAM和CLIP在医学图像分割中的应用问题。

per_question_results.question: 在遥感图像域适应中，EasySeg 和 PFM-JONet 有什么不同？
per_question_results.ground_truth: EasySeg 面向遥感图像语义分割，通过交互学习和主动学习结合的方式，引入 SFAL 策略和 ISS-Net 网络进行错误感知域适应。PFM-JONet 则利用提示基础模型进行混合训练，通过联合优化解决高分辨率城市场景的特征不一致性和域偏移问题。两者都面向遥感图像，但 EasySeg 更侧重交互式标注，PFM-JONet 更侧重基础模型。
per_question_results.answer:
您好！感谢您的提问，很高兴为您服务 😊  
根据您提供的知识库内容，EasySeg 和 PFM-JONet 是两种面向遥感图像语义分割域适应（DA）的不同方法，它们在任务定位、技术路线和核心创新点上存在明显区别。以下是基于知识库的客观对比：

1. **问题设定与学习范式不同**  
   - EasySeg 属于**主动域适应（ADA）框架**，强调“人机协同”，结合**交互式学习（interactive learning）与主动学习（active learning）**，需人工参与点级标注（如点击误判区域），以低成本获取误差感知且信息丰富的标签【来源：《EasySeg_An_Error-Aware_Domain_Adaptation_Framework_for_Remote_Sensing_Imagery_Semantic_Segmentation_via_Interactive_Learning_and_Active_Learning.pdf》】。  
   - PFM-JONet 属于**无监督域适应（UDA）框架**，完全不依赖目标域人工标注，而是通过**提示式基础模型（prompted foundation model, 如SAM）驱动的混合训练机制**实现跨域迁移【来源：《Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_VHR_Urban_Scene_Segmentation_via_Prompted_Foundation_Model-Based_Hybrid_Training_Joint-Optimized_Network (1).pdf》】。

2. **核心技术创新不同**  
   - EasySeg 提出“先看后问”（See-First-Ask-Later, SFAL）点级标注策略和交互式语义分割网络（ISS-Net），支持自动分割+人工点击反馈联合优化，并引入“click loss”保障交互输入被网络有效融合【来源：《EasySeg_An_Error-Aware_Domain_Adaptation_Framework_for_Remote_Sensing_Imagery_Semantic_Segmentation_via_Interactive_Learning_and_Active_Learning.pdf》】。  
   - PFM-JONet 则依托通用分割基础模型（如SAM）提取泛化特征，构建联合优化网络（Joint-Optimized Network），采用提示引导（prompted segmentor）与自训练（self-training）协同机制，在多个ISPRS基准任务（如Paris→Chicago、Potsdam→Vaihingen）上取得SOTA性能【来源：《Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_VHR_Urban_Scene_Segmentation_via_Prompted_Foundation_Model-Based_Hybrid_Training_Joint-Optimized_Network (1).pdf》】。

3. **评估侧重点不同**  
   - EasySeg 在实验中强调**更低标注成本下的更高精度**，其指标（OA、MA、F1、mIoU）优于现有ADA方法，甚至部分超越全监督模型【来源：《EasySeg_An_Error-Aware_Domain_Adaptation_Framework_for_Remote_Sensing_Imagery_Semantic_Segmentation_via_Interactive_Learning_and_Active_Learning.pdf》】。  
   - PFM-JONet 的对比聚焦于**UDA场景下的mIoU与类别级F-score提升**，例如在“Paris→Chicago”任务中比ST-DASegNet高出4.84% mIoU【来源：《Unsupervised_Domain_Adaptation_for_VHR_Urban_Scene_Segmentation_via_Prompted_Foundation_Model-Based_Hybrid_Training_Joint-Optimized_Network (1).pdf》】。

需要说明的是：知识库中未提供二者在相同数据集、相同评估协议下的直接对比实验；也未涉及模型部署效率、硬件需求或实际工程落地细节等信息。

EasySeg: An Error-Aware Domain Adaptation
Framework for Remote Sensing Imagery
Semantic Segmentation via Interactive
Learning and Active Learning
Liangzhe Yang
 , Hao Chen
 , Anran Yang, and Jun Li
Abstract — Semantic segmentation of remote sensing images
has attracted much attention for its wide applications. While
deep learning models have shown impressive performance in
this task, challenges arise when applying them to data from
other domains without fine-tuning, due to domain gaps. Domain
adaptation (DA) has emerged as a solution to bridge this gap.
Existing works mainly focus on unsupervised DA (UDA), which
lags far behind fully supervised models. However, active DA
(ADA) methods focused on natural images face challenges when
applied to remote sensing images due to pronounced domain
gaps and error unawareness problems. In this work, we propose
a novel error-aware DA framework for remote sensing imagery
semantic segmentation, called EasySeg, via interactive learning
and active learning. First, we introduce a point-level labeling
strategy, named “See-First-Ask-Later” (SFAL), combining both
interactive and active learning manners, allowing obvious errors
and information-rich pixels to be annotated easily and efficiently.
Then, we introduce an interactive semantic segmentation network
(ISS-Net), which can perform automatic semantic segmentation
and interactive refinement. Based on the acquired target point-
level labels, ISS-Net generates dense and accurate pseudo-labels
to enhance DA performance through retraining with consis-
tency regularization. Comprehensive experiments on two tasks
demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art
ADA methods in terms of overall accuracy (OA), mean accuracy
(MA), F1 score, and mean intersection of union (mIoU) with
lower labeling costs, even surpassing some fully supervised
models. The source code of EasySeg is freely available at
https://github.com/Yangliangzhe/EasySeg.

EasySeg for remote sensing imagery semantic segmentation,
incorporating both the advantages of interactive learning and
active learning. First, we propose a novel point-level labeling
strategy called “See-First-Ask-Later” (SFAL). In this strategy,users initially identify and label obvious mispredictions by
simply clicking at the centers of the erroneous regions.
Then, an active learning strategy is employed to query those
information-rich pixels in predictions. The core of the strategy
is to combine passive and active manners to make the acquired
labels both error-aware and information-rich at a low cost.
Second, considering the sparse nature of point-level labels in
the target domain, we introduce a novel Interactive Semantic
Segmentation Network for remote sensing imagery, called
ISS-Net. Besides the ability of automatic semantic segmenta-
tion, ISS-Net can also accept acquired target labels to generate
dense and precise pseudo-labels in an interactive semantic
segmentation manner. On one hand, we retrain our ISS-Net
through the pseudo-labels and consistency regularization [24]
to enhance automatic semantic segmentation performance on
the target domain. On the other hand, we design a click loss for
ISS-Net to ensure the fusion of automatic semantic segmenta-
tion and interactive segmentation, preventing the network from
disregarding interactive inputs.
Our main contributions can be summarized as follows.
1) We propose a novel DA framework named EasySeg for
remote sensing imagery semantic segmentation using
active learning and interactive learning, which allows
obvious errors and information-rich pixels to be labeled
efficiently at a low cost. To the best of our knowledge,
it is the first work to combine active learning and
interactive learning to do DA for remote sensing imagery
semantic segmentation.
2) An effective point-level labeling strategy and a novel
ISS-Net are proposed to mitigate the data gap from the
source domain to the target domain.
